[{"quickstart":{"display_name":"PCA","use_this_when":"Use this when one query should fit and transform its evaluated input relation for relational export or downstream visualization.","sql":"SELECT id, pc_0, pc_1
FROM cuvs_pca(
  input => (SELECT id, d0, d1 FROM input_vectors),

)

limitations_json: ["Fits and transforms the evaluated input in one call; it does not return a reusable transform, components, or explained-variance metadata.","The evaluated input needs at least two rows and two dimensions, and n_components must not exceed the evaluated dimension.","Component sign orientation is not a semantic label. The output schema changes with the literal n_components option."]
